facts.fact: Journal du Cameroun reports a contract signed 13 May 2024 with Augentic GmbH to build and operate a new identification system, with three card production centres, enrolment centres and 700 fixed and 300 mobile kits, first cards due by end 2024.

systems.owner: Delegation generale a la Surete nationale (contract party); Augentic operates for 15 years
